description: A JSON or YAML description of an HTTP API with its paths, operations, parameters, responses and schemas.
The unique name of an operation in the document, which a generator turns into the name of a client method.
The Spring library that builds the OpenAPI document from the mappings and types of a running application and serves it at /v3/api-docs.
TypeScript interfaces and services written by a generator from the document, regenerated on every contract change and never edited by hand.
An injection token that holds the server address, so tests and deployments change it with a provider instead of editing every method.
The immutable collection of query parameters that HttpClient encodes into the URL, whose set method returns a new object.
A 204 answer without a body, modeled as an Observable of void that still emits once and completes.
